predictions.quote: What you can do is you can cut smartly but also grow and get the economy in a position where that fiscal deficit is closer to 3% of GDP. Now yes we got to make more progress but if you look at what Scott has done at the Treasury I think that we are on pace to get to a point where we can get the fiscal deficit to a sustainable level
predictions.prediction: The US federal deficit will fall toward roughly 3% of GDP under the Trump administration's fiscal path.
